verdict.rationale: Appwrite provides a self-hosted, Docker-based platform, an official CLI (npm-installable, runs headlessly per hands-on probe) supporting scripted resource/function management, and functions triggerable via HTTP/webhooks/schedules — all enabling CI/automation workflows. An MCP server also exists for agent-driven automation, though it requires API key/project ID credentials at startup, a minor caveat rather than a blocker.
